comments_text: As a drug delivery system targeting cancer cell nucleus using CPP-Ts’s nuclear-targeting property.
cytotoxicity_text: HUV-EC-C, HFF-1, MCR-5, HEK-293, BHK-21, MDCK: sub peptide was unable to cross the cell membrane
target_organism_text: Tumor cells: DU145 (Sub peptide was internalized and directed to the intranuclear region.)
title: CPP-Ts: a new intracellular calcium channel modulator and a promising tool for drug delivery in cancer cells
